title: The Night Train
tagline: Train 217, sleeping car 7. A diamond has vanished.
intro: Winter, 1957. Night train 217 races towards Switzerland through the snowbound Jura.
In sleeping car 7, Countess Valmont screams: the Tear of Ophir, her diamond, was torn from her in the dark.
Next stop: Vallorbe, in forty-five minutes. The Sûreté is waiting there for a name and a hiding place. Each of you searches one part of the train.
ending: Under the hollow panel, wrapped in an embroidered handkerchief, the Tear of Ophir catches the light of the luggage van.
At Vallorbe, the inspectors climb aboard. The countess offers you a glass of champagne; the culprit steps down in handcuffs.
failEnding: The train pulls into Vallorbe. The doors open, the crowd mingles, and the culprit with it.
The diamond crosses the border without you. Try again.

zones.name: Compartment 7
flavor: A bottle of eau de Cologne, almost empty.
A Chaix railway guide, dog-eared at the Pontarlier page.
A cigarillo stub, smudged with lipstick.

zones.name: The luggage rack
flavor: A hotel label: “Grand Hôtel des Bains, Évian”.
A detective novel, its last chapter torn out.

zones.name: The dining car
flavor: A bill: two trout, one bottle of vin jaune.
A napkin embroidered with a V, folded into a swan.

zones.name: The corridor
flavor: A platform ticket, punched at Dijon.
A torn-off mother-of-pearl button, a bit of thread still attached.
The fogged window: someone has drawn a heart in it.

zones.name: The luggage van
flavor: A parcel addressed to a certain Mme Bellac, Lausanne.
A smell of coal and melting snow.

zones.name: The conductor's cabin
flavor: A brass whistle on a little chain.
A thermos of coffee, still hot.
